roll_calls.plain_language: H.R. 8464 (Stopping Fraudulent Payments Act) establishes requirements to prevent fraudulent or improper payments from federal programs. roll_calls.question: On Passage — Stopping Fraudulent Payments Act (H R 8464)
roll_calls.plain_language: This bill establishes requirements to prevent fraudulent or improper payments from federal programs. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

post.text:
$175 million of your money was about to go to dead people.
